ambiguities_or_notes: The 800-ruble paper estimate in Tolstoy’s body is preserved even though editorial note 3 says Kolbasin had asked for 300 rubles.
The references to Nekrasov’s poem, Nikolai Tolstoy’s Caucasus hunting sketches, the ninth issue, Tolstoy beginning Youth, and the promised Saturday letter are all represented.
All seven footnote references/definitions and the single page marker were checked.
